Chase Sui Wonders In Talks to Join A24’s ‘Goblin’
EXCLUSIVE: The Studio breakout Chase Sui Wonders is in talks to join Goblin , A24 ’s new film from David Mikalson, which goes into production next year.
Character details are being kept under wraps. Wonders joins a cast that includes Kenneth Branagh, voicing the titular Goblin, along with Skyler Gisondo and Will Forte. Previously, we reported that the film is a raunchy comedy in the vein of Ted meets E.T.
Sui Wonders is coming off of the first season of the hit Apple series The Studio , where she plays assistant-turned-executive Quinn Hackett. Her work there earned her a Gotham TV Award nomination; Season 2 of The Studio airs next year.
Currently, Sui Wonders is in production opposite Jennifer Aniston, Peter Dinklage and her The Studio co-star Ike Barinholz on Universal’s holiday comedy Naughty from director Olivia Wilde. Next up, she’ll be seen in A24’s Slayground , an action thriller written and directed by Jeremy Saulnier, which releases on January 29, 2027. She is represented by UTA and Sloane Offer Weber & Dern.
